{{Quote|I sense&hellip; a place I've been to before&hellip; waterfalls&hellip; Naboo.|Anakin Skywalker, sensing Cad Bane will go to Naboo|audio=APlaceIveBeenToBefore-CotF.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] underwent a mission in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to stop [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] from '''kidnapping''' potential [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]. Given the task of departing to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]; Skywalker left with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and rendezvous with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] Captain [[Lunker/Legends|Lunker]] inside the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Palace]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. While the two Jedi arrived before Bane did, the bounty hunter; however, landed near [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]] onboard his personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']].

Before Bane could kidnap the young Gungan infant, [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]], Tano emerged and fought the bounty hunter for a brief time. Attempting to evactute the city with his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]-equipped boots, Skywalker caught him, and soon he was placed with [[Binders/Legends|binders]]. Both Skywalker and Tano took Bane to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], where he was tortured until he revealed the location of the stolen [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I have delivered what you wanted; the Jedi were no problem. Anything else I can help you with?"''<br />''"I need test subjects. Four small children and bring them to Mustafar. I will take care of them."''<br />''"Kidnapping innocent children? Seems like a small-time crime for the likes of you."''<br />''"Among the children of the Jedi, there are no innocents."''<br />''"Sure, sure. As long as I get paid, it makes no difference to me.|Cad Bane and Sidious, discussing Bane's next mission|audio=INeedTestSubjects-CotF.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
[[File:Cad_Bane_holocron.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Cad Bane steals a holocron from the Jedi Temple]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Children of the Force Date" /> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] successfully [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stole]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], which contained information about the location of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After Bane's success in [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|obtaining]] the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]] at [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], Bane retreated to his [[Black Stall Station/Legends|station]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The bounty hunter contacted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], and told him that he retrieved both the holocron and crystal for him. Offering to help the Dark Lord once more, Bane asked the latter if he needed something else to be "taken care of." Agreeing to Bane's wish, Sidious gave Bane a new mission: capture a total of four Force-sensitive infants, that are listed in the holocron, and deliver them to the remote planet of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] planned to use them as test subjects in his experiments for the alteration of Force-sensitives to build his own personal corps of [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="CotF" />

On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] meditated, along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Skywalker saw a vision of Bane on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. As Kenobi, Windu, and Yoda sensed that Bane was after other children as well, they departed and began their separate missions to stop Bane. While Kenobi left for [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], Skywalker, along with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], traveled to Naboo, where they were greeted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. The captain introduced the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to [[Lunker/Legends|Lunker]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] captain in charge of the operation of stopping Bane. Tano told Skywalker that she should go with the Gungan, and Skywalker agreed. While Tano and Lunker proceeded to the [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]], Skywalker promised to follow them shortly.<ref name="CotF" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Don't move, sleemo!"''<br />''"You weren't the child I was expecting to find."''<br />''"Obviously."''<br />''"You're quite clever, but naive.|Cad Bane, before engaging Ahsoka Tano in a duel|audio=DontMoveSleemo-ChildrenOfTheForce.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
[[File:Bane_captured.png|thumb|left|230px|Bane is taken prisoner on Naboo]]

Landing near the city of Jan-gwa city, Bane left his personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]],<ref name="CotF" /> the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']],<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> and headed toward the above ground Gungan city. On his list, the bounty hunter was after a [[Gender/Legends|female]] infant Gungan named [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]], who was with her mother. After Bane entered the city, he soon arrived to his destination, and spotted the Gungan mother leaving an infant cradle. As the mother left the room, the bounty hunter approached it, and noticed a sheet covering something small underneath. Upon lifting the sheet,<ref name="CotF" /> a toy tooka doll was exposed,<ref name="Ep Guide" /> with Page not found in the cradle. Behind Bane, Tano emerged from behind a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]]. Knowing that the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Padawan hid the child from him, the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] bounty hunter engaged her in a duel. Using his [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord launcher]], that was activated through his [[Gauntlet/Legends|wrist gaunlet]], Bane grabbed the Padawan's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from her grasp. Retrieving one of his [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistols]], the bounty hunter began to shoot at Tano, although the unarmed Tano dodged Bane's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, and hid behind some furniture. However, as she attempted to retrieve her fallen lightsaber, Bane evacuated the room using his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]]-equipped boots. Before Bane could escape the city, Skywalker appeared on top of a roof, and grabbed onto Bane's boots. With the extra weight, Bane's boosters were disabled, and as the two tumbled onto a roof below, the hunter's hat was knocked off. The pair struggled before landing on the ground, and the outmatched Bane looked up to see Tano's ignited lightsaber pointing at his face.<ref name="CotF" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We know you've taken at least two children; were are they?"''<br />''"Beyond your reach."''<br />''"Who are you working for?"''<br />''"I work alone.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Mace Windu, interrogate Cad Bane after his capture on Naboo|audio=IWorkAlone-CotF.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
Upon capturing Bane, Tano placed the bounty hunter in [[Binders/Legends|binders]]. The Padawan noticed a familiar item, which was clipped on Bane's belt, and took it from him. Knowing that Bane might not be a threat to Page, Tano told the mother of the infant Gungan that her daughter was safe; however, her statement caused Bane to release his anger at her. Although, Skywalker began to push Bane out the room. Taking Bane captive,<ref name="CotF" /> the two Jedi sent the Duros to Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']].<ref name="Ep Guide" /> After Kenobi failed to [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|stop]] Bane on Rodia&mdash;prior to Bane's arrival on Naboo&mdash;he joined Skywalker, Tano, and Windu on the detention block inside the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="CotF" />

[[File:Mind-trick_combined.png|thumb|right|250px|Windu, Kenobi and Skywalker interrogate Bane with the Force.]]

Skywalker and Tano remained outside the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] room, while Kenobi and Windu interrogated the headstrong bounty hunter. After the two Jedi Masters couldn't force Bane to reveal the location of the children and holocron, they subsided and returned to Skywalker. After Tano suggested the use of a "three-way" [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], the Jedi reentered the room and began to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] Bane through the Force. The Duros gave in, and soon agreed to [[Mission to Black Stall Station/Legends|take]] Kenobi and Windu to the location of the holocron, while Skywalker and Tano remain on the ''Resolute'', and scan through Bane's captured starfighter.<ref name="CotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This mission served as one of the four missions Cad Bane took, which first appeared in "[[Children of the Force]]," the third episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The episode aired on [[October 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="Ep Guide" />
